content:
Diego Santos  [root]
Oncall heads up: pilot install failing in locked-down VPC (no NAT). Installer preflight passes DNS + ECR endpoints, but it blows up right after bootstrap with STS errors.

Snippet from customer run:
```
[preflight] ✅ ecr.api endpoint reachable
[preflight] ✅ ecr.dkr endpoint reachable
[preflight] ✅ s3 gateway route present
[preflight] ✅ logs endpoint reachable

error: aws sts GetCallerIdentity: RequestError: send request failed
caused by: Post "https://sts.us-east-1.amazonaws.com/": dial tcp: i/o timeout
```
Looks like missing `com.amazonaws.us-east-1.sts` interface endpoint (Private DNS).

Colin O'Donnell
Yep, this is AcmeBank pilot. They’re running the installer from an EC2 in the Private subnets (no public egress). They explicitly didn’t create STS endpoint because it wasn’t in the quickstart list. :grimacing:

Benji Okafor
That error is consistent w/ SDK trying to call STS for caller identity + role chaining we do during install. If there’s no NAT, STS has to be an interface endpoint.

Ethan Park
+1. We should treat STS as required for “private-only egress” topologies. The installer currently only hard-checks ECR/S3/Logs.

Irene Choi
For private-only VPC, required interface endpoints should include:
- sts
- ecr.api
- ecr.dkr
- logs
(and s3 gateway)
Optional: ssm/ec2messages/ssmmessages depending on customer ops.

Victor Alvarez
Workaround for the pilot:
1) Add interface endpoint: `com.amazonaws.us-east-1.sts` in the same subnets where installer/control plane runs
2) Attach SG allowing 443 from the Private subnets (or the installer SG)
3) Enable `private_dns_enabled = true` (important so `sts.<region>.amazonaws.com` resolves to the endpoint)
Then re-run preflight and install.

Bruno Silva
I can jump on a quick call w/ them. In the meantime, easiest validation from the same EC2:
```
aws sts get-caller-identity
curl -sS https://sts.us-east-1.amazonaws.com/ -o /dev/null -w "%{http_code}\n"
```
If `curl` hangs, endpoint/DNS isn’t right.

Marcus Lin
Security POV: STS endpoint is fine/expected. Better than opening broad egress just to hit public STS. Make sure endpoint policy is least-privilege (we can ship a stub in the module but customer can tighten).

Kevin Osei
Also note: if they have custom resolver rules, Private DNS on the endpoint won’t help unless their resolver honors the VPC private hosted zone. We should call this out in troubleshooting.

Diego Santos
Ack. I’ll message Colin to tell the customer to add STS endpoint + private DNS and rerun.

Talia Benson
We need a follow-up ticket so this doesn’t keep happening in pilots. Can someone file against endpoints module + installer preflight?

Sahana Iyer
Filed Linear: ENG-4872 “Add STS endpoint to required set for private-only installs + installer preflight check + docs update”. Assigned to Benji + me for preflight bits. Link: https://linear.app/redwood/issue/ENG-4872

Benji Okafor
:+1: I’ll update the installer preflight to explicitly test `aws sts get-caller-identity` (or a direct HTTPS reachability check) and return actionable error: “Missing STS VPC endpoint (com.amazonaws.<region>.sts) or Private DNS not enabled”.

Ethan Park
And I’ll update the Terraform module defaults / docs to include STS in the “required endpoints” matrix for no-NAT mode. We should also note it in the quickstart.

Colin O'Donnell
Thanks. I’m relaying the workaround now. Will update this thread once they confirm.

Colin O'Donnell  [later]
Customer added `com.amazonaws.us-east-1.sts` endpoint + enabled private DNS. `aws sts get-caller-identity` now returns. Installer resumed and got past bootstrap. Still running but looks good.

Diego Santos
Awesome. Marking incident as mitigated w/ workaround. Keeping ENG-4872 open for permanent fix + doc updates.

(reactions: Diego Santos added :white_check_mark: to Sahana Iyer’s ticket message; Irene Choi added :eyes: to Victor Alvarez’s workaround)
